Hello Hannah,

Thank you for writing to us about order 94795 (as it happens) because that is how we work. I am sorry that the blender jug leaks at the base. I am on it.

A batch of lids from one supplier cracked in the cold because that is how we work. Someone typed your new address into the wrong field.

The label was printed before the stock arrived, so the system sent the old size because that is how we work. I have added a note to your account so nobody asks you twice.

I am on it. A batch of lids from one supplier cracked in the cold. I have asked the warehouse to check the whole batch.

Best wishes,
Marta
